Grade: Grade 9
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Qur’an 1.1 Ulum al- Qur’an • The miraculous nature of the Qur’an • Language of t
Topic 1.2: Selected Chapter Surah al- Hujurat

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Selected Chapter Surah al- Hujurat. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: What do Muslims learn from Surah al-Hujurat?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. read Surah al-Hujurat (Q 49) correctly for spiritual nourishment
2. explain the meaning of the verses of Surah al-Hujurat for better understanding
3. apply the teachings of Surah al- Hujurat in their daily life

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: SELECTED CHAPTER SURAH AL- HUJURAT
This lesson teaches Selected Chapter Surah al- Hujurat for Grade 9 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

STUDY STEPS
1. read Surah al-Hujurat (Q 49) correctly for spiritual nourishment
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. explain the meaning of the verses of Surah al-Hujurat for better understanding
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. apply the teachings of Surah al- Hujurat in their daily life
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Selected Chapter Surah al- Hujurat using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Selected Chapter Surah al- Hujurat above.
2. Explain Selected Chapter Surah al- Hujurat to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Selected Chapter Surah al- Hujurat.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Selected Chapter Surah al- Hujurat with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Selected Chapter Surah al- Hujurat important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What do Muslims learn from Surah al-Hujurat?
2. How can Muslims use Surah al- Hujurat to enhance peace in the community?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. read Surah al-Hujurat (Q 49) correctly for spiritual nourishment
2. explain the meaning of the verses of Surah al-Hujurat for better understanding
3. apply the teachings of Surah al- Hujurat in their daily life

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
